question: According to the International Football Association Board (IFAB), which colour must the football goal post be?
solution:
The correct answer is __**White**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the International Football Association Board (IFAB), the football goal post must be **white**.
 
• The color specification ensures that the goalposts are clearly visible during matches.
 
• This rule is part of the Laws of the Game, which are maintained by IFAB to standardize football regulations globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The International Football Association Board (IFAB) was founded in 1886 and is responsible for overseeing the Laws of the Game of football.
 
• IFAB consists of representatives from the football associations of England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, and FIFA.
 
• The Laws of the Game cover all aspects of football including the field of play, the ball, the players, and the equipment used.
 
• Goalposts and crossbars must be made of approved materials and have a consistent color, which is mandated to be white for clarity and uniformity.
